steps: Greet the customer and confirm the request to open a new account.
Ask the customer to provide their full legal name for verification.
Verify the customer's identity using a government-issued ID (if available).
Request the customer's current residential address for record-keeping.
Ask for the customer's date of birth to comply with KYC regulations.
Inquire about the type of identification document the customer holds (e.g., passport, driver’s license).
Explain the available account types and recommend the most suitable one.
Ask if the customer wishes to make an initial deposit and specify the amount.
Confirm the preferred currency for the account (e.g., USD, EUR, local currency).
Complete the account application form with the collected information.
Review all entered details with the customer for accuracy and obtain their signature.
Submit the application for backend processing and provide the customer with a confirmation receipt.
